question: Which five elements are enumerated as the core components of this teaching, O Shiva?
premises: Wine, meat, and fish are explicitly named.
Gesture and sexual union are also named.
Together they form a set of five elements.
inference: The teaching enumerates wine, meat, fish, gesture, and sexual union as the five elements.
plain_english: O Shiva, they are wine, meat, fish, gesture, and sexual union.
